data.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Raises $333M Selling MSTR Stock, Leaves Bitcoin Stash Untouched
data.description: Michael Saylor’s Strategy (MSTR) did not buy or sell any Bitcoin (BTC) over the past week, but the company continued to raise cash by selling its own stock.According to an 8-K filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Strategy sold about 3.5 million shares of MSTR common stock throu…
